cards.$comment: Repo override (operator go 2026-10-10): dedupe mechanical card filings before filing. cards.dedupe on = a finding already on an OPEN card (same target file, same defect class, claim similarity >= cards.similarity) becomes an 'Also raised by' line on that card instead of a new card. Cascade: standard default (off) -> platform preference (cards in scripts/lib/delivery-platform-preferences.json) -> this file -> env (WE_CARDS_DEDUPE, WE_CARDS_DEDUPE_SIMILARITY). See scripts/lib/card-dedupe.mjs; calibrate with scripts/operations/card-dedupe-replay.mjs. The comment lives under cards (not at the top level) so it never collides with another settings file's top-level $comment (settings-files: one owner file per leaf).
